title: Learning Path
description: A progressive route from programming and data skills to practical machine-learning workflows.

tracks.title: Python & Programming
tracks.description: Learn Python fundamentals, data structures and practical data handling.

modules.title: Python Fundamentals
modules.description: Variables, data types, conditions, loops, collections, functions, and debugging.

modules.title: NumPy and pandas
modules.description: Inspect, filter, clean, and prepare datasets.

tracks.title: Mathematics for AI
tracks.description: Build probability and statistical reasoning, then use linked references to study linear algebra and discrete mathematics.

modules.title: Statistics and Probability
modules.description: Summary statistics, variation, distributions, sampling, and correlation.

modules.title: Linear Algebra Foundations
modules.description: Supplementary external reading on vectors, matrices, and transformations; a dedicated local lesson is not yet included.
outcomes: Connect array operations to model inputs

modules.title: Discrete Mathematics Practice
modules.description: Supplementary external reading for logic, sets, counting, and combinatorics; a dedicated local lesson is not yet included.

tracks.title: Machine Learning
tracks.description: Train baseline models, compare approaches, and evaluate generalization.

modules.title: Regression
modules.description: Predict numerical targets and compare a model against a baseline.

modules.title: Classification
modules.description: Train classifiers, inspect probabilities, and choose decision thresholds.

modules.title: Model Evaluation
modules.description: Use validation correctly and identify leakage, imbalance, and misleading metrics.

tracks.title: Computer Vision
tracks.description: Start with image classification and learn how convolutional networks process images.

modules.title: Image Classification with a CNN
modules.description: External guided tutorial; this is a linked reference rather than a local IOAI Lab lesson.

completion_rules.lesson_complete_when: The learner marks the lesson complete after reviewing the lesson and attempting its quiz or exercises.
completion_rules.progress_storage: Progress requires frontend persistence; this JSON file defines curriculum content and does not store user progress.

content_notes: Local lesson paths refer to repository files; the website must resolve them relative to its content base URL or fetch them from GitHub raw URLs.
External-reference modules are intentionally labelled and should not be counted as local lesson files.
Do not show completion or quiz scores until the frontend has implemented those behaviors.
